name: Capability-scoped sandbox
description: Runtime primitive that begins with nearly no ambient authority and explicitly grants capabilities resource by resource, enabling safe execution of untrusted user-generated code with tight permission control, fast enough for interactive requests

edges.quote: once users have access to systems that can generate code on their behalf, the next important question is not just how smart the model is. it is whether our software platforms are prepared to host user-specific code safely, quickly, and with tight control

instead of beginning with a miniature server and then trying to constrain it, you begin with an isolate that has almost no ambient authority and then explicitly hand it the capabilities it should have
